name: Huawei Cloud Data Lake Insight
summary: Run Data Lake Insight SQL jobs through the Huawei Cloud API and load staged Parquet from OBS into DLI tables, once per partition and revision.

fields.name: iam_token
fields.label: IAM token
fields.help: A token for the project; short-lived.

settings.name: project_id
settings.label: Project ID
settings.help: The project of the region, from My Credentials in the console.

settings.name: queue
settings.label: Queue
settings.help: The DLI queue that runs the jobs.

operators.summary: Run a SQL job on a queue and keep the result as Parquet.
Load staged Parquet from OBS into a DLI table with a job, once per partition and revision.

notes: Staging and job results use Huawei OBS; add the Huawei OBS connector's domains to the same egress approval. The table must already exist.
